notes: GAAP county, governmental activities only, no business-type funds (business_type null). Receipts/disbursements from p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column. Debt_proceeds = leases + subscriptions issued (other financing sources). Balance sheet from the p3 government-wide Statement of Net Position (single Governmental Activities column). ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5) cash and pooled investments, total column; restricted assets 51,353,215 separate. Detail: General, Road, Health Center and DC Justice Center budget-basis schedules (pp7-11; budget basis differs from GAAP); nonmajor detail uses the Total Nonmajor Special Revenue Funds column (p13; 18 fund columns on pp12-13) and the Total Nonmajor Debt Service Funds column (p14); together they equal the p14 Total Nonmajor Governmental Funds column. The Tourism fund's 'Other' taxes 5,776,868 are Miscellaneous Tax per the Douglas County ruling; the statement's Miscellaneous taxes line 8,497,254 also includes General Fund 2,720,386 and stays other taxes. Pages 1-2 are table-of-contents pages; pages 15-19 are statistical schedules with no financial data. Read pages 1-19 of 19
